sloka: दुष्करं निष्प्रतिद्वन्द्वं चिकीर्षन् कर्म वानरः ।समुदग्रशिरोग्रीवो गवांपतिरिवाबभौ ॥५-१-२॥
transliteration: duṣkaraṁ niṣpratidvandvaṁ cikīrṣan karma vānaraḥ ।samudagraśirogrīvo gavāṁpatirivābabhau ॥5-1-2॥

translations.english: Hanuman who raised his head and neck, intending to cross the formidable ocean which none else could accomplish, looked like a leading bull.
